title: 第八章 为了活下去你什么都可以做？
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

东山小红低着头，双手不听使唤似的颤颤巍巍。

“呜呜……”她发出呜咽声，本能地想要停止，但理智却警告她不能惹怒眼前这个男人。

在整个过程中，言良始终坐在干硬的床沿上，什么都没说，什么也没做，就这么看着眼前的东山小红。

巨大的羞耻如同海啸般将她淹没。可是，每当她想要停下的时候，脑海里就会浮现出废弃大楼里那满地的无头尸体。

而就在小红认命般地准备继续时——

“你先停下吧。”

言良的声音，在这房间中突兀地响起来了。

小红的动作僵住，她睁开红肿的双眼看向言良。

“你在干什么？我让你脱，但是我没让你哭。”言良同样看着她：“我对这种强迫性的戏码没有任何兴趣，太掉价了。”

实际上，言良刚才只是想做一个测试，而现在他已经得到结果了，自然也没有心情去继续捉弄东山小红。

并且，在如今这种什么都不能做的【氛围】下，他也想不出来还要怎么惩罚东山小红。

总不能让人家真脱了，趴下来给自己当椅子谢罪吧？

这种不利于身心健康和正确三观建立的事情，是万万不能做的。

东山小红愣住了，大脑完全无法处理目前的情况。

不满意？那他到底想干什么？！

“有点眼力见吧……”

“难道没有看到我还在流血吗？”

言良叹了口气，抬起左臂露出了一道划伤。那是在大楼中契约斩杀线恶魔时所留下的伤口，此刻鲜血还在顺着手腕往下滴落。

“既然你口口声声说为了补偿我什么都愿意做，那就先把我手上的伤口处理好。还是说，比起包扎伤口，你其实更期待我刚才顺水推舟做点什么？”

“不、不是的！我马上做！”

东山小红连忙冲向了房间角落的壁橱，不多时，她就抱着一个简易的医药箱回到了言良面前。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Dongshan Xiaohong lowered his head and his hands trembled as if he couldn't control them.

"Woo..." She whimpered, instinctively wanting to stop, but her reason warned her not to anger the man in front of her.

During the whole process, Yan Liang sat on the edge of the hard bed, saying nothing or doing nothing, just looking at Dongshan Xiaohong in front of him.

The huge shame overwhelmed her like a tsunami.However, whenever she wanted to stop, the headless corpses all over the ground in the abandoned building would come to her mind.

And just when Xiaohong was ready to continue as if she was resigned to her fate——

"You should stop first."

Yan Liang's voice suddenly sounded in the room.

Xiao Hong's movements froze, and she opened her red and swollen eyes to look at Yan Liang.

"What are you doing? I asked you to take off your clothes, but I didn't let you cry." Yan Liang also looked at her: "I have no interest in this kind of forced drama, it's too cheap."

In fact, Yan Liang just wanted to do a test just now, but now that he has got the results, he is naturally not in the mood to continue teasing Dongshan Xiaohong.

Moreover, in this [atmosphere] where nothing can be done, he can't think of how to punish Dongshan Xiaohong.

You can't let someone really take off their clothes and lie down and use it as a chair to apologize, right?

This kind of thing that is not conducive to physical and mental health and the establishment of correct three views must not be done.

Dongshan Xiaohong was stunned, her brain completely unable to process the current situation.

Not satisfied?So what does he want to do?!

"You must have some discernment..."

"Didn't you see that I'm still bleeding?"

Yanliang sighed and raised his left arm, revealing a scratch.That was the wound left when he contracted to kill the line demon in the building, and blood was still dripping down his wrist at this moment.

"Since you keep saying that you are willing to do anything to compensate me, then take care of the wound on my hand first. Or, rather than bandaging the wound, do you actually expect me to do something along the way?"

"No, no! I'll do it right away!"

Dongshan Xiaohong hurriedly rushed to the closet in the corner of the room. After a while, she returned to Yan Liang holding a simple medical kit.
